declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The settlement was negotiated through two rounds of confidential mediation communications. In the first round, class counsel proposed a $30 million class fund and $10 million in attorneys’ fees and expenses, with automatic distribution, a clear-sailing provision, and any fee amount not awarded by the court reverting to the class. Brightline proposed a $27 million class fund and $7 million in fees, with the same distribution and fee-reversion terms. In the second round, class counsel proposed a $29 million class fund and $8 million in fees, retaining automatic distribution, clear sailing, and reversion of unawarded fees to the class. Brightline accepted that proposal, subject to court approval. The class-relief and fee terms were negotiated together; fees were not discussed only after class relief had been agreed.
